method: Unfold by reflecting punches across each fold line in reverse order
steps: Fold 1: top third folded down; fold 2: the now two-layer middle band folded down onto the bottom third
Punches in the bottom-third strip: a pair near its top, a single near its bottom (3 layers)
Bottom layer: pair at 0.75, single at 0.89 of height; middle layer (reflect about 2/3): pair 0.59, single 0.44
Top-to-bottom: pair, single, single, pair, pair, single = option C; A, B, D have other orders or counts
